A '''Separatist official''' sat next to [[Tikkes]] during the [[Executive Separatist Council]]'s meeting on [[Utapau]]<ref name="EpisodeIII" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> They were present when [[General]] [[Grievous]] ordered the relocation of the council to [[Mustafar]].<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Separatist official first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="EpisodeIII" /> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] noted that the character was shot into the scene as a separate stage element, but he has never been able to find a name for the character, nor still photographs from that shoot.<ref name="PabloTweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1533986072589307906|Pablo Hidalgo|quote=Never been able to figure out who this guy at the end is. Shot as a separate stage element at ILM, no still photography exists of the shoot. Kinda looks like an Aqualish maybe? Maybe I'll pick up that mystery again someday.|archivedate=20220607013621}}</ref>
